name: tenderned-mcp
description: TenderNed (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /publicaties?page (0-based)&size: the latest TenderNed publications, newest first, as listed on data.overheid.nl ('publicatie Webservice (TNS)'). The dataset page documents only page and size, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are ignored; filter the rows yourself. Rows carry publicatieId, publicatieDatum, aanbestedingNaam, opdrachtgeverNaam, typePublicatie {code, omschrijving} (e.g. AAO aankondiging, AGO gegunde opdracht), procedure, typeOpdracht (D/L/W) and a link to the notice page (in raw). No budget is published in the list.
